ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60% low-intensity (black) to 40% high-intensity (white/scarred) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large high-intensity white regions occupy the distal tips of both lobes. The medial and proximal regions feature a high density of discrete white circular rings and mottled blobs on a continuous low-intensity black background.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped median notch with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 48 degrees and a narrow vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern (sawtooth denticles) along the entire trailing edge; peak-to-valley pixel amplitude increases significantly toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edges exhibit a predominantly convex trajectory from the notch to the tips, with a slight sigmoidal transition near the mid-lobe point.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial distribution of high-contrast white circular ring clusters (rosettes) across the entire ventral field, most concentrated in the central zones of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, unaligned white linear streaks (rake marks) are visible, notably a long diagonal mark on the left lobe (viewer perspective) and shorter horizontal disruptions on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense circular scarring pattern globally distributed; distinct clusters of brownish-orange pixels (likely cyamids/whale lice) are visible at the fluke-peduncle junction and on the outer distal tip of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The frequency and density of the rosette-style scarring are exceptionally high, creating a 'polka-dot' or 'leopard' pixel texture that nearly occludes the base black pigmentation in the mid-fluke region.
